description: This file defines a unit test class 'UniqueRouteKeyTest' for verifying the uniqueness of route keys across plugin configuration files in a Symfony-based PHP project. It loads route configurations from plugin YAML files and checks for duplicate route keys, reporting any conflicts.

classes.name: UniqueRouteKeyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that checks for duplicate route keys in plugin route YAML configuration files.

methods.name: testUniqueRouteKey
methods.description: Loads plugin route configuration files, collects route keys, and asserts their uniqueness, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.
